title: More access for image-feed listeners
summary:
The image feed gained authenticated access, while the community project directory got a larger crop of things to explore.

Authenticated listeners can now receive additional image-feed events, including events replayed when they connect. The existing content filters remain in place for public listeners.

The project directory added chat tools, image generators, interactive stories, a picture-book plugin, video-thumbnail tooling, and MVKProject Nexus API. KoboldAI gained a featured spot, corrected links and creator credit, while sorting changes make featured projects appear in the intended order.

Images generated with meoow models now use the standard logo. An affiliate rotation weight was also adjusted.

highlights.title: More community projects
highlights.text: Explore new community builds for interactive stories, picture books, chat, image generation, and video thumbnails. [Browse the showcase](https://pollinations.ai).
